title: Houthis Threaten Riyadh for First Time, Claim Strike on Yanbu Aramco Facility
detail: Yemen's Houthi movement claimed missile and drone attacks on 'sensitive sites' in Riyadh and an Aramco oil facility in Yanbu — the first time the group has threatened the Saudi capital since Yemen's civil war resumed. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a ballistic missile fired at Riyadh at dawn; smoke was seen near a fuel depot close to King Khalid International Airport before an all-clear was issued. Coalition spokesperson Maj. Gen. Turki al-Maliki said additional attempted strikes on Yanbu, Bisha, Taif and Farasan were thwarted by air defenses.

media.caption: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile fired at Riyadh

title: Iran's Rezaei Says Tehran Has Conveyed Conditions to Mediators to End War with US
detail: Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Rezaei said Iran conveyed conditions for ending the war with the US to Qatari and Pakistani mediators: ending the war on all fronts, unfreezing Iranian funds, and lifting the US naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz. Rezaei said Tehran is awaiting a response from President Trump.

title: Two IDF Soldiers Lightly Injured in Southern Lebanon; Israel Strikes Hezbollah in Retaliation
detail: Two IDF soldiers sustained light injuries in an incident in southern Lebanon, prompting the Israeli military to carry out multiple retaliatory strikes against Hezbollah targets in the area.
